title: Different graft thicknesses after Descemet stripping endothelial keratoplasty for bullous keratopathy in the two eyes of the same patient

indication: Bilateral bullous keratopathy after cataract surgery in a 75-year-old woman with bilateral Fuchs dystrophy (pseudophakic; total corneal decompensation, endothelial cell density not detectable preoperatively)

groups.description: Case report: DSAEK in both eyes of one patient by one experienced surgeon, right eye first and left eye 6 months later; peribulbar anesthesia, 4.5-mm temporal clear corneal incision, 8.0-mm descemetorhexis, precut eye-bank grafts (single microkeratome pass, trephined 8.0 mm) pulled in with a Busin glide, air tamponade partly exchanged for BSS after 20 min; tobramycin, dexamethasone and diclofenac for 2 weeks, then clobetasone for 3 months; no intraoperative or postoperative complications

series.baseline_label: Right eye corneal thickness before surgery (Table 1 row 'Before surgery', column 'Corneal thickness (µm)' RE); AS-OCT (RTVue, Optovue)
series.notes: Table 1 rows Before surgery, 1, 6, 12 and 24 months after this eye's DSAEK; total corneal thickness including the DSAEK lenticule (Abstract 'overall corneal thickness'; Case report gives corneal thickness 'with a lenticule thickness of' the graft); single measurement per visit

series.baseline_label: Left eye corneal thickness before surgery (Table 1 row 'Before surgery', column 'Corneal thickness (µm)' LE); AS-OCT (RTVue, Optovue)
series.notes: Table 1 rows Before surgery, 1, 6, 12 and 24 months after this eye's DSAEK (operated 6 months after the right eye); total corneal thickness including the DSAEK lenticule; single measurement per visit

exclusions.what: Table 1 columns 'Graft thickness (µm)' RE and LE (C6, C7)
exclusions.reason: Graft-only thickness; protocol uses the total corneal thickness for DSAEK

exclusions.what: Eye-bank estimated precut donor graft thickness (Abstract)
exclusions.reason: Donor graft-only value, not the patient's corneal thickness

exclusions.what: Table 1 columns CDVA (Snellen), RMS and Endothelial count

notes: Per-eye rows of a two-eye case report: kind individual, one series per eye; both eyes belong to the same patient and are not independent.
Role: standard DSAEK with eye-bank precut grafts and no investigational agent; the different graft thicknesses were unplanned (Conclusion): control.
The article reports 'corneal thickness' by AS-OCT without stating the measurement location; it is taken as the central corneal thickness admitted by triage. Flagged for review.
Follow-up times are relative to each eye's own DSAEK (Case report: examination before each surgery and at 1, 6, 12 and 24 months after each DSAEK).
